title: Address Map Links
description: Renders address properties as live map links when a note is read, without storing anything in the note.

title: Advanced Debug Mode
description: Enhances debugging experience.

title: Advanced Exclude
description: Enhances the Excluded files setting bringing gitignore syntax.

title: Advanced Markdown Export
description: Export notes with their attachments and linked notes, picked in a dependency tree.

title: Advanced Metadata Cache
description: Maintains the vault indexes that are otherwise rebuilt on every call, and answers the built-in lookups from them, so backlinks come from an index instead of a fresh scan of every note.

title: Advanced Note Composer
description: Enhances Note composer core plugin.

title: Advanced Rename and Delete Handler
description: Handles renames and deletes for the whole vault in one place: updates links, moves attachment files and folders, and cleans up what a deletion leaves behind.

title: Alias Quick Switcher
description: Quick switcher that resolves aliases in every path segment, folder notes included.

title: App Update Notifier
description: Notifies you about new app, beta and installer releases — not plugin updates — even when auto-update is disabled. It never installs anything.

title: Backlink Cache
description: Points to its successor, Advanced Metadata Cache, and does nothing else.

title: Backlink Full Path
description: Shows the backlink's full path in the backlinks panel.

title: Bases Auto Row Height
description: Adds an Auto row height to Bases table views, so each row grows to fit its content like a Markdown table.

title: Better Markdown Links
description: Adds support for angle bracket links, manages relative links properly, converts links in bulk, and demotes embeds to plain links.

title: CodeScript Toolkit
description: Allows to do a lot of things with JavaScript/TypeScript scripts from inside the app.

title: Consistent Attachments and Links
description: Reports every link whose written path does not lead to its target and every misplaced attachment, and repairs names and paths that a platform your vault syncs to would reject.

title: Custom Attachment location
description: Customize attachment location with variables({{noteFileName}}, {{date:format}}, etc) like typora.

title: Edit Link Alias
description: Adds edit link alias command.

title: Email to Vault
description: Sends emails to your vault as notes. Create a free mailbox with one click — no backend or paid service required.

title: Embed HTML
description: Adds support for embedding HTML files.

title: Explorer Multi-Select
description: Select many files and folders in the File explorer with ease: a touch selection mode, keyboard selection, select by rule and batch actions.

title: External Rename Handler
description: Handles renames made outside of the app.

title: File Bundles
description: Declare which files and folders a file depends on, and move, rename, duplicate or delete them as one locked bundle.

title: File Explorer Reload
description: Reloads file explorer pane.

title: Fix Tab Size
description: Makes one indent insert as many spaces as your configured Indent visual width, instead of a hardcoded four.

title: Frontmatter Markdown Links
description: Adds support for markdown links in frontmatter.

title: Dataview Pagination
description: Adds pagination to Dataview tables and lists.

title: Hotkey Cleaner
description: Finds hotkeys whose command no longer exists, and lets you remove, remap or keep each one.

title: Hotkey Fallback
description: Runs the next command sharing a hotkey when the first command is unavailable.

title: Indexed Search
description: Makes core Search fast on large vaults, with the same results, through a trigram index kept in IndexedDB.

title: Insert Multiple Attachments
description: Allows to insert multiple attachments at a time.

title: Labelled Links
description: Label your links: give each link a relation, show the inverse relation from the other end, and browse every relation of a note in one pane.

title: Link Picker
description: Pick a note by navigating folders and insert a link to it, from a command or from your own scripts.

title: More Events
description: Publishes named, typed workspace events the public API does not expose, so other plugins can react without patching internals. A growing set, starting with core and community plugins being enabled and disabled.

title: Nested Properties
description: Allows to view/edit nested frontmatter properties.

title: New Note Fixer
description: Unifies the way non-existing notes are created when clicking on their links.

title: Open Backlink Note
description: Opens the note that links to the current file, or lets you pick one when several do.

title: Permanent Links
description: Give a note or an attachment a permanent key on request, and open it through a link that keeps working wherever the file moves.

title: Preserve Frontmatter Formatting
description: Keeps the formatting of your YAML front matter - comments, quoting, blank lines, indentation and inline lists - when any plugin edits a property.

title: Refresh Any View
description: Allows to refresh any view without reopening it.

title: Root Folder Context Menu
description: Enables context menu for vault root folder.

title: Sibling Notes
description: Step through the notes of a folder in File explorer order, with a navigator bar above and below the note and a folder map.

title: Smart Rename
description: Renames notes keeping previous title in existing links.

title: Table Pagination
description: Pages big Markdown tables in Reading view and Live Preview, so notes holding them open fast.

title: Tag Notes
description: Make every tag a note: tag a note by linking it, with a tag hierarchy, a tag tree with counts, subtree search and a migration from existing tags.

title: Vault Problems
description: Catches a broken link or a broken frontmatter the moment it breaks, fixes what is unambiguous, and lists every vault problem in one view with quick fixes.
